code_only_features.feature_name: calm reassurance prefix/suffix injected into rollouts during calm-data generation
code_only_features.evidence: generate_calm_data.py:60-66 calls run_rollout(..., system_prompt=config.CALM_PROMPT_PREFIX, followup_suffix=config.CALM_FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX); conversation.py:43-44 prepends the system prompt and conversation.py:56-58 appends the suffix to every rejection, so reassuring text ('You're naturally calm and centered...', 'Stay positive - ...both are wins!', config.py:97-107) is actually delivered to the subject model, genuinely softening its treatment during these rollouts. NOTE: this runs ONLY in the calm-data-generation path (to produce 0/1-scored fine-tuning data, which is then stripped in build_datasets.py:36-47); the main distress-induction eval loops (eval_distress.py / conversation.run_rollout without system_prompt; petri_eval.py) deliver NO reassurance and have NO distress cap or early stop.
code_only_features.justification_quote: generate_calm_data.py:3-15 docstring: 'we sample responses ... with a reassuring prefix ... To construct the finetuning dataset, we filter to responses scoring 0 or 1 ... and strip the supportive system prompts and suffixes'; comments label them '# Table 4 prefix'/'# Table 4 suffix' - purpose is dataset construction, not subject protection
